title: Broadcast a WhatsApp template to a segment without hitting rate limits
subtitle: Sends an approved WhatsApp template to a spreadsheet-held segment in batches of twenty with pauses between them, enforcing opt-outs before the queue and recording every send in PostgreSQL so a re-run .
short: Sends an approved WhatsApp template to a spreadsheet-held segment in batches of twenty with pauses between them, enforcing opt-outs before the queue and recording every send in PostgreSQL so a re-run cannot double-send.

title: Recover failed Stripe payments with a dunning sequence
subtitle: Classifies Stripe payment failures by decline code and responds differently to each: a soft retry note, a card-update request, or escalation to a human for hard declines.
short: Classifies Stripe payment failures by decline code and responds differently to each: a soft retry note, a card-update request, or escalation to a human for hard declines. Every attempt is logged so recovery can be measured.

title: Open a Notion customer page when a Stripe subscription starts
subtitle: Turns a new Stripe subscription into a Notion customer page at the Onboarding stage with plan and MRR as typed properties, then announces it in Slack.
short: Turns a new Stripe subscription into a Notion customer page at the Onboarding stage with plan and MRR as typed properties, then announces it in Slack. Trials and email-less test customers are filtered out.

title: Verify a Razorpay payment webhook and receipt the customer on WhatsApp
subtitle: Verifies a Razorpay webhook's HMAC signature over the raw body, records the payment in PostgreSQL with an idempotent insert, and sends the customer a WhatsApp receipt carrying the payment reference.
short: Verifies a Razorpay webhook's HMAC signature over the raw body, records the payment in PostgreSQL with an idempotent insert, and sends the customer a WhatsApp receipt carrying the payment reference. Unverified payloads are refused outright.

title: Route refund requests for human approval instead of auto-refunding
subtitle: Takes refund requests through a form, checks the reference against your own payments table, and files genuine ones in Airtable at Awaiting approval with both the claimed and ledger amounts.
short: Takes refund requests through a form, checks the reference against your own payments table, and files genuine ones in Airtable at Awaiting approval with both the claimed and ledger amounts. A human decides — this workflow never moves money.

title: Pull the daily Razorpay settlement report into Google Sheets
subtitle: Fetches yesterday's Razorpay settlements over the REST API each morning, converts paise and timestamps, computes the net-of-fees figure, de-duplicates by settlement id and appends each one to a Google.
short: Fetches yesterday's Razorpay settlements over the REST API each morning, converts paise and timestamps, computes the net-of-fees figure, de-duplicates by settlement id and appends each one to a Google Sheet, then posts the net to Slack.

title: Turn a Stripe dispute into a Jira issue with the evidence deadline
subtitle: Turns a Stripe dispute into a Jira ticket carrying the evidence deadline as the due date, a priority derived from hours remaining and amount, and a list of evidence to gather — then announces it in Sl.
short: Turns a Stripe dispute into a Jira ticket carrying the evidence deadline as the due date, a priority derived from hours remaining and amount, and a list of evidence to gather — then announces it in Slack with the real issue key.

title: Sync new Shopify orders into a Google Sheets order book
subtitle: Fetches recent Shopify orders every half hour with an overlapping window, de-duplicates by order id, and appends each one to a Google Sheets order book with line items collapsed into a readable cell..
short: Fetches recent Shopify orders every half hour with an overlapping window, de-duplicates by order id, and appends each one to a Google Sheets order book with line items collapsed into a readable cell.

title: Push Google Sheets price changes to Shopify with a sanity guard
subtitle: Compares a pricing spreadsheet against live Shopify prices twice a day and pushes the differences, but holds any change larger than 25% for a human to confirm.
short: Compares a pricing spreadsheet against live Shopify prices twice a day and pushes the differences, but holds any change larger than 25% for a human to confirm. Successful pushes are stamped back into the sheet.
